metadata.description: Android installer app that runs the real RuneLite client on Samsung Tab S10 Ultra via Termux + proot-distro
metadata.session_notes: Session 37: 6-wave review-fix-verify cycle (12 review agents, 21 fixes, 17 files). Standard + production-scrutiny reviews. Shell injection fix, deployment caching, credential scrubbing, process death handling, corruption recovery. 4 logical commits.

resolved_blockers.description: GeckoView auth integration designed and approved (Session 33). Needed implementation and on-device verification.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Implemented in Session 34. All 3 phases complete, 6 quality gates passed. Fragment capture confirmed working in onLoadRequest. Full end-to-end auth flow verified on device.

resolved_blockers.description: Credential env file written to app's private filesDir was not readable by Termux (different UID).
resolved_blockers.resolution: Deploy env file via TermuxCommandRunner.execute() with stdin, writing to Termux home dir.

resolved_blockers.description: Android blocks bind() to port 80 for ALL apps. Jagex consent redirect goes to http://localhost (port 80).
resolved_blockers.resolution: GeckoView intercepts navigation at engine level before network request. No port 80 needed.

resolved_blockers.description: OAuth 2-step flow design approved but code not yet written.
resolved_blockers.resolution: Full implementation completed in Session 30. Replaced with GeckoView auth in Session 34.
Changed SetupStep.allSteps from eager val to by lazy

resolved_blockers.description: SecurityException crash when verifyPermissions() runs before RUN_COMMAND permission granted
resolved_blockers.resolution: Added try/catch SecurityException in verifyPermissions() returning false
Changed to MutableStateFlow<Boolean> and used combine()

resolved_blockers.description: Cloudflare blocks Android WebView auth page
Chrome Custom Tabs onNavigationEvent doesn't reliably provide redirect URL
proot-distro install returns non-zero due to /proc/self/fd warnings

resolved_blockers.resolution: Removed deferred cancellation from onDestroy, added stopSelfIfIdle

resolved_blockers.description: Termux wraps results in Bundle extra, not flat extras
